title: Sally Bowles is whoever you want her to be #cabaretmusical #theatre #...
transcript: I absolutely love theatre discourse like should Sally Bowles be a good singer because both sides are correct and that is what I love about theatre because two different people can look at the same character in the same work of art and have completely different visions for how she should be portrayed and discourse like this gets people to start thinking about art at the level of like a director or a dramaturg it gets people to start looking into the text and looking for reasons to support their vision of why they think that Sally Bowles should be able to sing well or not you could look at the source material of which cabaret is based off of where it directly refers to Sally Bowles as somebody who cannot sing very well you can look at the fact that she's been working in this club that she's kind of expendable that she hasn't become a bigger star there's also plenty of reasons why somebody who's incredibly talented would be stuck at a cabaret and not be able to move up in the world like her lifestyle choices which are very evident in the text of cabaret when you have somebody like Marisha Wallace playing the show her race becomes a factor of maybe that is the reason why she's not moving up in this world of 1930s Germany there's also the interpretation that the actual Sally Bowles is not a great singer but because cliff is writing the story after the fact that he has chosen to make her the singer that she always wanted to be there's so many different interpretations that could support either conclusion and that's the really cool thing about art is that two different performers can bring something completely new to a role and you can have an interpretation that you prefer one that resonates with you more but there's not ever objectively one correct way to do a role in the same way that a director can have a completely different vision for a work of art and they both work with the text and the next level to that is thinking okay not just does this vision work but how does this vision help to reflect the world that is around me right now why is this the version of the story that we need at this moment that becomes really interesting when you start to analyse the different endings of cabaret that we've gotten from the last two major revivals but I feel like that's a whole different video anyway all this to say art is cool and completely subjective and I love that you all are thinking of well how do I interpret this specific role because that's that's what theatre artists do right they take text and they see a vision for it whether that is as a performer or as a director
